shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 3 on the number line in the left image with the marker at 3 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The upper trace excludes the right boundary 3. Right image: The selected leftward ray excludes 3.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
